description: Put local files (images, videos, PDFs) into a page that takes them by drag-and-drop or by paste — post composers (X, Threads, Bluesky, Instagram web), dropzones, chat boxes — when there is no file input to use with upload_file. mode "drop" (default) drops them on the element as a real browser drag; mode "paste" pastes them into it like Ctrl+V of a copied file. Paths must be absolute.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12".

selector.description: CSS selector of the drop zone / editor, when it has no ref.

name: drop_files
